description: Use to calculate one scenario from a local workbook with changed constant inputs and selected cells, ranges or defined names as outputs. Returns full-precision numbers, strings, booleans, null for direct blanks and {error: code} for spreadsheet errors; named references to blanks return 0, dates are serial numbers in the workbook's date system and ranges are arrays of rows. Each call starts from the original workbook and includes compatibility warnings; formula cells cannot be inputs. Responses are capped at 20000 bytes including both copies; oversized results return an explicit error.

inputs.description: Single constant or blank cells Sheet!A1, or defined names referring to one cell, mapped to numbers, strings or booleans.

outputs.description: Sheet!A1, Sheet!A1:B5 or defined names; at most 10,000 output cells total.

path.description: Local workbook path (absolute recommended), at most 50 MiB; .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx or .xltm.

name: calculate
